_comment: Deep key-parity baseline: per-locale (missing|extra) leaf-key counts vs `en` (source of truth). The 14 locale files are NOT yet fully aligned (pre-existing fragmentation). localeConsistency.test.js fails only when a locale's counts GROW beyond this baseline (i.e. new divergence). When divergence is intentionally reduced, shrink these numbers to lock the improvement. Do NOT increase them to silence a regression.
